## R Markdown

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.



```{r}
# Load the Libraries that will be required for Analysis
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

# Load the dataset from the computer that I am working on
file_path <- "PlasmodiumPseudoResultsKJE.xlsx"
data <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Sheet1")

# Convert date columns to Date type
data <- data %>%
  mutate(`Collection Date` = as.Date(`Collection Date`),
         `Date of Gel` = as.Date(`Date of Gel`))
```


```{r}
# Plasmodium results, count, and proportion of plasmodium for each species 
plasmodium_counts <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Plasmodium (+/-)`)) %>%
  group_by(`Plasmodium (+/-)`) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count))

print(plasmodium_counts)
```


```{r}
# Creating a BarPlot to Display Overall Plasmodium Detection Results
ggplot(plasmodium_counts, aes(x = `Plasmodium (+/-)`, y = Count, fill = `Plasmodium (+/-)`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Plasmodium Detection Results", x = "Result", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Species-Specific Analysis of Count, Porportion, and Plasmodium Results
species_detection <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), !is.na(`Plasmodium (+/-)`)) %>%
  group_by(Species, `Plasmodium (+/-)`) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count))

print(species_detection)
```
```{r}
# Creating a stacked Barplot to show the number of positives and negatives for plasmodium results in each species tested
ggplot(species_detection, aes(x = Species, y = Count, fill = `Plasmodium (+/-)`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Plasmodium Detection by Species", x = "Species", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
# Temporal Analysis
# Sample collection trends
collection_trends <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Collection Date`)) %>%
  group_by(Year = year(`Collection Date`)) %>%
  summarise(Count = n())

print(collection_trends)
```
